summary: Manual GO-LIVE test pack for the Saranam India Health Care Analytics module. Covers the Analytics Dashboard shell at /analytics (permission guard view_analytics), tab/view navigation, the four LIVE views (Patient Analysis, Form Analysis, Vitals Analysis, Donor/ToC Analytics), the shared DateRangePicker (presets + custom calendar), the patient-type filter, Refresh, the ExportButton (PDF + CSV), the donor sub-controls (period selector, demo/real-data toggle, Refresh, browser-print PDF), and every backend endpoint in app/analytics/routes.py reachable from the UI. Includes loading/skeleton states, empty-data states, API 4xx/5xx/timeout error handling, permission/session checks, and cross-module data-integrity checks. The /analytics/forms and /analytics/forms/:formId Advanced Form Analytics sub-pages are covered only with light load/guard cases — deep form-analytics testing is OUT OF SCOPE for this engagement.
in_scope: Permission guard on /analytics: ProtectedRoute requiredPermission="view_analytics" — access granted with the permission, Access Denied / login redirect without it
Analytics Dashboard shell: header title + dynamic subtitle, tab toggle group (Patient, Forms, Vitals, Donor/ToC), default view on load (Patient), per-view sub-controls visibility

Patient Analysis view: Total/New/Total-Forms StatCards, Palliative Outcomes cards (Deaths 30d, Avg Visits Before Death), Deaths Over Time line chart, Age Distribution bar, Gender Distribution pie, Registration Trends line, embedded Vitals Analysis block; GET /analytics/dashboard + GET /analytics/deaths/impact

Form Analysis view: Total Forms / Total Submissions / Completion Rate / Avg Completion Time StatCards, Completion Funnel, Submission Status pie, Top Forms bar, Submission Trends line, 'Advanced Form Analytics Hub' button; GET /analytics/forms

Vitals Analysis view (own tab + embedded under Patient): Patients Tracked / Deaths / Avg Visits KPI cards, Vitals Distribution chart with 7 vital toggles, Vitals vs ESAS/PPS correlation chart with ESAS/PPS switch; GET /analytics/vitals/summary, /vitals/distribution, /vitals/correlation, /deaths/impact

Donor / ToC Analytics view: 12 StatTiles, period selector (daily/monthly/quarterly/yearly), demo-data/real-data toggle, Refresh, browser-print PDF, Time-to-first-visit, Deaths by location, Visits-over-time stacked bar, KMs/week, Deaths over time, Consultation mix, Opioid/Telemedicine timelines, Follow-ups, Place-of-death-by-zone, Enrolment-to-death, Vehicle utilization; all 14 GET /analytics/donor/* endpoints

Shared DateRangePicker: 6 quick presets (Last 7 days / 30 days / 3 months / 6 months / 12 months / Year-to-date), custom 2-month range calendar, future dates disabled, data refresh on range change, default Last-12-months range
Patient-type filter (All / New / Active) on the Patient view and its patient_type query param
Refresh button (re-fetch current view) and loading spinner / skeleton behaviour
ExportButton: Export dropdown, PDF Report (jsPDF) and CSV Data download for Patient and Form views; export content reflects current data and date range
Auth header attachment (Bearer access_token) on every analytics request and 401 behaviour
Cross-module data integrity: analytics figures vs Patients module counts; newly added data appears after refresh
Light coverage of /analytics/forms (Advanced Form Analytics Hub) and /analytics/forms/:formId load + permission guard
out_of_scope: Deep Advanced Form Analytics testing (FormAnalyticsHub, FormDeepDiveView, FieldDropoffFunnel, FieldValueDistribution, UsageHeatmap and the /analytics/forms/advanced/* endpoints) — only that /analytics/forms and /analytics/forms/:formId load and are permission-guarded is in scope

Hidden / commented-out analytics views (Symptoms, Risk, Geospatial, Provider Optimization, Clinical Outcomes, Operational/Financial) — their tabs and conditional renders are commented out in AnalyticsDashboard.jsx and are NOT reachable from the UI; their endpoints exist on the backend but are not exercised by the shipped UI

Backend endpoints with no live UI caller: /analytics/patients/demographics, /analytics/trends/registration, /analytics/reports/user-activity, /analytics/reports/form-comparison, /analytics/custom, /analytics/export, /analytics/symptoms/*, /analytics/risk/*, /analytics/geo/*, /analytics/optimization/*, /analytics/clinical/*, /analytics/operational/* (documented for reference only)
Byte-level correctness of generated PDF / CSV files (only that download triggers and opens, and headline figures are present)
Statistical / clinical accuracy of the underlying analytics computations (only that the API returns and the chart renders the returned numbers)
Login screen internals (only redirect-to-login behaviour on missing permission / expired session is covered)
Map tile rendering / Leaflet internals (Geospatial view is hidden and out of scope)

screens.name: Analytics Dashboard (Patient / Forms / Vitals / Donor-ToC tabs)
Advanced Form Analytics Hub (light coverage only)

roles_and_access: All three analytics routes (/analytics, /analytics/forms, /analytics/forms/:formId) are wrapped in ProtectedRoute with requiredPermission="view_analytics". A logged-in user WITH the view_analytics permission sees the dashboard; a logged-in user WITHOUT it is shown the in-app 'Access Denied — You don't have permission to access this page.' panel (ProtectedRoute). An unauthenticated user (no user in AuthContext) is redirected to /login. Every analytics API request requires a valid JWT in the Authorization Bearer header; the backend routes are decorated with @require_auth and return 401 when the token is missing/invalid. NOTE: the AnalyticsDashboard, VitalsAnalysisView and DonorAnalyticsView issue their data calls with a RAW axios instance + manually attached localStorage access_token (VITE_API_BASE_URL), NOT the shared apiClient — so the automatic 401 refresh-and-retry interceptor in api/client.js does NOT apply to these calls; an expired token surfaces as an error state rather than a silent token refresh.

api_endpoints.purpose: Patient-view metrics. Query: start_date, end_date (sent as full ISO timestamps by the UI), patient_type (new|active when filter != all), filters (JSON). Returns summary{total_patients,new_patients,active_patients,total_forms,growth_rate}, demographics{age_distribution,gender_distribution}, trends{registration_over_time,...}. 200 ok; 500 {error} on failure.

Palliative outcome KPIs. Query window_days (default 30, must be 1..3650 else 400). Returns deaths_in_window, avg_visits_before_death, deaths_by_month, deceased_patients. Used by Patient view + Vitals view.

Form-view analytics. Query start_date, end_date. Returns summary{total_forms,total_submissions,average_completion_rate,average_completion_time_minutes}, status_breakdown, top_forms, submission_trends, completion_funnel. 200 ok; 500 {error}.
Population vitals improvement summary. Returns {success,data:{total_patients_with_vitals,vitals_summary{...}}}. Powers Patients-Tracked KPI + improvement aggregates.

Distribution of latest vital values across patients, keyed by vital (bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, pr, spo2, temperature, rr, grbs) with buckets, normal_range, unit, total. Powers the Vitals Distribution chart.
Correlate vitals change vs ESAS/PPS score change. Query score_type=esas|pps (default esas). Returns correlations{vital:{improved/stable/deteriorated:{avg_score_change}}}, patients_with_both.
Most improved/deteriorated patients. Query direction=improved|deteriorated, limit (default 10). Defined in api/analytics.js but the UI fetch is commented out — endpoint exists, no live caller.
Donor StatTiles + previous-period deltas. Query start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD). 400 on bad date; 500 {error}.
Bucketed visit counts split by visit_location (home/opd/ipd/phone). Query start_date,end_date,period (daily|monthly|quarterly|yearly).
Bucketed raw death counts (no spike suppression). Query start_date,end_date,period.
Team-role encounter counts across visits in the period. Query start_date,end_date.
Estimated KMs/week from approved weekly schedules. Query start_date,end_date.
Opioid/morphine usage: distinct-patient count + dispensation timeline. Query start_date,end_date,period.
Teleconsult session counts (video+voice). Query start_date,end_date,period.
Avg distinct team-roles per home visit + multi-disciplinary visit %. Query start_date,end_date.
Patients receiving follow-up visits + follow-up volume timeline. Query start_date,end_date,period.
Deceased counts grouped by (zone, place_of_death); also totals_by_place/totals_by_zone/grand_total. Query start_date,end_date.
Active alive patients with no completed visit in N+ days. Query threshold_days (default 60), limit (default 50). Note: UI calls this WITHOUT period/date params.
Per-vehicle weekly slot count + utilization % vs target. Query start_date,end_date,target_slots_per_week (default 25).
Distribution of days from enrolment to death; flags late-referral patterns. Query start_date,end_date.
Time from registration to first completed visit in home-care days. Query start_date,end_date,target_homecare_days (default 8, must be 1..365 else 400).
(OUT OF SCOPE / light) Advanced form overview for /analytics/forms deep-dive.
(OUT OF SCOPE / light) Field drop-off funnel for a form.
(OUT OF SCOPE / light) Day-vs-hour usage heatmap for a form.
(OUT OF SCOPE / light) Value distribution for a field. Query field_type.

test_data_setup: Account A — 'analyst@saranam.test': logged-in user WHOSE role/permission set INCLUDES view_analytics (e.g. admin or analytics-enabled role).
Account B — 'fieldnurse@saranam.test': logged-in user WHOSE role/permission set does NOT include view_analytics (to verify Access Denied).

At least ~30-50 patients in the database spanning multiple age bands (e.g. Infant 0-1, Adult, Senior, Super-senior 80+), both genders, and an 'Unknown (no DOB)' band; registered across 2025-06 to 2026-05 so registration-trend and demographic charts are non-trivial.

At least a handful of deceased patients within the last 30 days (with visits logged before death) so Deaths(30d) and Avg-Visits-Before-Death are non-zero; plus deceased patients with enrolment dates and place_of_death + zone for donor charts.
Patients with both initial and follow-up vitals (BP, PR, SpO2, temperature, RR, GRBS) and ESAS/PPS scores so vitals summary/distribution/correlation return data.
Visits across home/opd/ipd/phone locations, some with team_members carrying role labels, plus teleconsult sessions and opioid (narcotic) dispensations so the donor timelines are populated.
Approved weekly schedules with vehicles assigned (e.g. KA-01-AB-1234) so distance + vehicle-utilization charts render.
Several published forms with submissions in varied statuses (draft/submitted/verified) within the test window for the Form view.
Known reference counts noted before testing: exact total patient count from the Patients module list (for data-integrity comparison) and the count of patients registered in a chosen month.
A test window of interest: 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-31 (custom range) and the default Last-12-months (2025-06-01 to 2026-06-01).
Browser DevTools available (Network + Console tabs) to verify API calls, query params, status codes, and to simulate offline/throttled/blocked responses.
Production URL https://saranam.fieldintel.ai reachable; today's date treated as 2026-06-01.

test_cases.title: User WITH view_analytics permission can open /analytics
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as Account A (has view_analytics).
steps: Navigate to /analytics (via the Analytics nav item or direct URL).
test_cases.expected_result: The Analytics Dashboard renders: 'Analytics Dashboard' title, the tab toggle group (Patient, Forms, Vitals, Donor / ToC), date controls and the Patient view content. No Access Denied panel.

test_cases.title: User WITHOUT view_analytics permission is blocked
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as Account B (no view_analytics).
steps: Attempt to open /analytics via direct URL.
test_cases.expected_result: ProtectedRoute renders the 'Access Denied — You don't have permission to access this page.' panel. The dashboard content and any analytics API call are NOT made.

test_cases.title: Unauthenticated access to /analytics redirects to login
test_cases.preconditions: No active session (localStorage cleared / logged out).
steps: Clear localStorage (access_token, refresh_token, user) or log out.
test_cases.expected_result: ProtectedRoute finds no user and redirects to /login (Navigate replace). The Analytics Dashboard is not shown.

test_cases.title: Analytics API requires a valid Bearer token (401 when missing)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A logged in; DevTools available.
steps: In DevTools, manually delete/blank the access_token in localStorage, then trigger a refresh of the Patient view (Refresh button or change date range).
test_cases.expected_result: Request goes out with an invalid/empty Authorization header; backend (@require_auth) returns 401. The dashboard shows the red 'Error loading dashboard' panel with a 'Try Again' button (no app crash). NOTE: because the dashboard uses raw axios, the apiClient 401 refresh-and-retry does NOT run.

test_cases.title: Default view on load is Patient with Last-12-months range
test_cases.preconditions: Account A logged in.
steps: Observe which tab is active and the date range shown in the picker.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Patient' tab is active (highlighted) by default. The DateRangePicker shows a range from ~12 months ago to today (e.g. Jun 1, 2025 - Jun 1, 2026). The patient-type filter (All Patients) is visible only on this view.

test_cases.title: Tab navigation switches between all four live views
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on /analytics.
steps: Click the 'Forms' tab; observe content and subtitle.
Click the 'Donor / ToC' tab; observe content.
test_cases.expected_result: Each click activates the corresponding tab (highlighted) and renders that view's content. The header subtitle updates per view (e.g. 'form usage and completion', 'vital sign trends and clinical correlations', 'Theory of Change-aligned stewardship', 'patient demographics and operational'). Only one view is visible at a time.

test_cases.title: Only Patient / Forms / Vitals / Donor tabs are present (hidden views absent)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on /analytics.
steps: Confirm which tab buttons are rendered.
test_cases.expected_result: Exactly four tab buttons render: Patient, Forms, Vitals, Donor / ToC. The Symptoms, Risk, Geospatial, Optimization, Outcomes and Financial tabs are NOT present (commented out in code) and there is no way to reach those views from the UI.

test_cases.title: Loading skeletons appear while patient data is fetched
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; DevTools Network throttling set to Slow 3G.
steps: Observe the StatCards and ChartCards during the fetch.
test_cases.expected_result: While loading, StatCards and ChartCards show skeleton placeholders (grey shimmer blocks) instead of values/charts; once /analytics/dashboard resolves, real values and charts replace them. The Refresh icon spins while loading.

test_cases.title: Dashboard error panel renders when /analytics/dashboard fails (500)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; ability to force the dashboard call to fail (DevTools request block or backend 500).
steps: Block or force a 500 on GET /api/analytics/dashboard, then click Refresh.
test_cases.expected_result: The page shows the red 'Error loading dashboard' box with the server error message and a 'Try Again' button. No blank screen or JS crash. Clicking 'Try Again' re-issues the fetch.

test_cases.title: Refresh button re-fetches the active view
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on /analytics (Patient view); DevTools Network open.
steps: Note the current /api/analytics/dashboard request in Network.
test_cases.expected_result: A fresh GET /api/analytics/dashboard fires with the same current params; the Refresh icon spins (animate-spin) and is disabled while loading; data re-renders on completion. On the Forms tab the same button refetches /api/analytics/forms.

test_cases.title: Summary StatCards render correct headline figures
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view with data present.
steps: Read the three top StatCards: Total Patients, New Patients, Total Forms.
Compare values to the /api/analytics/dashboard summary in Network.
test_cases.expected_result: Total Patients = summary.total_patients, New Patients = summary.new_patients (with a growth_rate trend badge vs last month), Total Forms = summary.total_forms, all locale-formatted (e.g. 1,234). Values match the API JSON exactly.

test_cases.title: Palliative Outcomes cards reflect deaths/impact (window_days=30)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; at least one death recorded in last 30 days.
steps: Read the 'Deaths (Last 30 Days)' and 'Avg Visits Before Death' cards.
test_cases.expected_result: Deaths (Last 30 Days) = deaths_in_window; Avg Visits Before Death = avg_visits_before_death formatted to 1 decimal. These cards fetch independently and keep their own loading skeleton; a deaths/impact failure does NOT blank the other StatCards.

test_cases.title: Deaths Over Time line chart renders monthly series
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; deaths recorded across multiple months.
test_cases.expected_result: A red line chart plots deaths_by_month (month on X, count on Y, integer Y axis). Hover tooltip shows the death count labelled 'Deaths'. Description reads 'Monthly deaths in the last 12 months'.

test_cases.title: Age Distribution bar chart shows banded labels with ranges
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; patients across multiple age bands incl. an Unknown (no DOB) band.
steps: Inspect the 'Age Distribution' bar chart X-axis labels and bar heights.
Compare to demographics.age_distribution in the API.
test_cases.expected_result: Each bar's X label is the band name plus numeric range (e.g. 'Infant (0-1)', 'Super senior (80+)') when min_age is present, and 'Unknown (no DOB)' unchanged. Bar counts equal demographics.age_distribution[].count. Labels are angled -30deg and all show (interval=0).

test_cases.title: Gender Distribution pie shows percentage labels and Unknown handling
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; patients of both genders + at least one null gender.
steps: Inspect the 'Gender Distribution' pie slices and labels.
test_cases.expected_result: Pie slices map to gender_distribution; each label reads 'Name: percentage%'. A null/blank gender renders as 'Unknown'. Slice values equal item.count and percentages match the API percentage field.

test_cases.title: Registration Trends line chart plots registrations over time
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; registrations spread over the period.
test_cases.expected_result: Line chart with month on X and New-Patients count on Y, matching trends.registration_over_time[].month/.count. Hover tooltip shows the count.

test_cases.title: Patient-type filter (New) re-fetches with patient_type=new
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view; DevTools Network open.
steps: Open the patient filter Select (default 'All Patients').
test_cases.expected_result: Selecting 'New Patients' triggers a refetch with query param patient_type=new (and patient_type=active for 'Active Patients'). 'All Patients' omits the param entirely (undefined). Charts/StatCards update to the filtered figures.

test_cases.title: Embedded Vitals Analysis block renders under the Patient view
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view with vitals data.
steps: Scroll to the bottom of the Patient view.
Observe its KPI cards and charts.
test_cases.expected_result: A 'Vitals Analysis' heading is shown followed by the full VitalsAnalysisView (Patients Tracked / Deaths / Avg-Visits KPIs, Vitals Distribution, Correlation). It self-fetches its own data, so it appears even though the Patient view passes it no props. (Note: this is the SAME component also shown as the standalone Vitals tab — vitals/summary, /distribution, /correlation, /deaths-impact are called again here.)

test_cases.title: Empty patient data renders zeros and empty charts (no crash)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; choose a date range with NO patients (e.g. start_date in the far past with no registrations, or a future-narrow window with no data).
steps: Pick a custom range that contains no patient/registration data.
test_cases.test_data: Custom range with no records (e.g. 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-02 on an empty dataset)
test_cases.expected_result: StatCards show '0' (Total/New Patients/Total Forms). Charts render empty axes with no bars/lines instead of erroring. Deaths cards show 0 and 0.0. No JS error in console.

test_cases.title: Forms tab loads four StatCards from /analytics/forms
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; forms + submissions exist in the window.
test_cases.expected_result: Total Forms = summary.total_forms, Total Submissions = summary.total_submissions, Completion Rate = average_completion_rate% , Avg Completion Time = average_completion_time_minutes min. Values match the API. A GET /api/analytics/forms request fires when the tab activates.

test_cases.title: Completion funnel + submission/verification rates render
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Forms tab with completion_funnel data.
steps: Read the Submission Rate and Verification Rate figures.
test_cases.expected_result: Horizontal bars for Started / Submitted / Verified with values from completion_funnel. The two stat lines show completion_funnel.submission_rate% (green) and verification_rate% (purple).

test_cases.title: Submission Status pie, Top Forms bar, and Submission Trends line render
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Forms tab with data.
steps: Inspect 'Top Forms by Usage' bar (names truncated to 20 chars + ...).
test_cases.expected_result: Status pie slices = status_breakdown (status capitalised, value=count, label %). Top Forms bars = top_forms[].submissions with form_name truncated past 20 chars. Trends line plots submission_trends[].month/.submissions.

test_cases.title: 'Advanced Form Analytics Hub' button navigates to /analytics/forms
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Forms tab.
steps: Click the 'Advanced Form Analytics Hub' button (shown only on the Forms tab).
test_cases.expected_result: Navigates to /analytics/forms (Advanced Form Analytics Hub). Deep testing of that page is OUT OF SCOPE — only confirm it loads under the view_analytics guard.

test_cases.title: Forms tab with no submissions shows zero stats and empty charts
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; pick a window with no submissions.
steps: On the Forms tab, set a date range with no form submissions.
test_cases.expected_result: StatCards show 0 / 0% / 0 min; funnel, pie, bar and line charts render empty without error. No console crash.

test_cases.title: Forms API failure surfaces the dashboard error panel
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Forms tab; ability to force 500 on /analytics/forms.
test_cases.expected_result: The shared 'Error loading dashboard' panel appears with the error text and 'Try Again'. (The dashboard's error state is shared across views.) No crash.

test_cases.title: Vitals tab loads KPI cards (Patients Tracked, Deaths, Avg Visits)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; vitals + deaths data present.
steps: Observe the three KPI cards while/after loading.
Inspect the parallel requests in Network.
test_cases.expected_result: On mount, vitals/summary, vitals/distribution and deaths/impact?window_days=30 fire in parallel. 'Patients Tracked' = total_patients_with_vitals; 'Deaths (last 30 days)' = deaths_in_window; 'Avg Visits Before Death' = avg_visits_before_death (1 dp) or em-dash when null. A simple 'Loading vitals analytics...' message shows during the fetch.

test_cases.title: Vitals Distribution chart switches across all 7 vital toggles
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Vitals tab with distribution data.
steps: Default vital is BP Systolic; note the chart.
Click each toggle in turn: BP Diastolic, Pulse Rate, SpO2, Temperature, Resp. Rate, GRBS.
Read the 'Normal range' footnote for each.
test_cases.test_data: vitals: bp_systolic, bp_diastolic, pr, spo2, temperature, rr, grbs
test_cases.expected_result: Each toggle re-renders the distribution bar chart from distributionData[vital].buckets (no new network call — distribution is fetched once). The footnote shows that vital's normal_range, unit and total patient count. Selected toggle is highlighted blue.

test_cases.title: Vitals vs ESAS/PPS correlation toggles between score types
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Vitals tab.
test_cases.expected_result: Switching to PPS fires GET /api/analytics/vitals/correlation?score_type=pps and the chart + title update to 'Vitals vs PPS Correlation'. The subtitle shows patients_with_both count when present. Switching back to ESAS refetches score_type=esas.

test_cases.title: Vitals charts show empty-state text when no data
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; dataset with no follow-up vitals / no correlation pairs.
steps: Open the Vitals tab on a dataset with no usable vitals.
Observe the distribution and correlation cards.
test_cases.expected_result: Distribution card shows 'No distribution data'; correlation card shows 'No correlation data'. KPI cards show 0 / em-dash. No crash.

test_cases.title: Deaths/impact failure degrades gracefully on the Vitals tab
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Vitals tab; force deaths/impact to fail.
test_cases.expected_result: The deaths fetch is caught (.catch returns {data:null}); Deaths and Avg-Visits cards fall back to 0 / em-dash while Patients-Tracked and the distribution chart still render. No error panel, no crash (failure is isolated).

test_cases.title: Donor tab loads all 14 endpoints and Row-1/Row-2 StatTiles
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; donor data populated; default real-data mode.
steps: In Network, confirm the parallel /api/analytics/donor/* calls.

Read the StatTiles (New registrations, Unique patients seen, Total visits, Home-care first/follow-up, Deaths, Consultations, Multi-disciplinary, Patients on opioids, KMs covered, Lost to follow-up, Telemedicine).
test_cases.expected_result: Fourteen donor endpoints fire (overview, visits-timeline, deaths-timeline, consultations-mix, distance-timeline, opioid-usage, telemedicine-timeline, multidisciplinary, followups, place-of-death-by-zone, loss-to-followup, vehicle-utilization, enrollment-to-death, registration-to-first-visit). StatTiles populate from each response with previous-period delta badges (TrendingUp/Down or 'No prior data'). Numbers use Indian grouping (en-IN).

test_cases.title: Period selector changes bucketing param on timeline endpoints
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab (real data).
steps: Inspect the period query param on the donor timeline calls each time.
test_cases.expected_result: Each selection refetches the donor data with the chosen period value; the visits/deaths/opioid/telemedicine/followup timelines re-bucket accordingly. The Period selector is DISABLED while demo mode is on.

test_cases.title: Demo/real-data toggle switches to fabricated mock data (no API)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab; DevTools Network open.
steps: Note the toggle label reads 'Real data' by default.
Flip the Switch so it reads 'Showing demo data'.
Watch Network and the on-screen amber banner.
test_cases.expected_result: Flipping the toggle to demo mode fills every card from getMockDonorData() and makes NO /api/analytics/donor/* network calls. An amber banner appears: 'Demo mode — showing fabricated 12-month data ...'. DEFECT/RISK to flag for go-live: a user could present mock numbers (e.g. 104 deaths, 165-patient first-visit cohort) believing they are real if the toggle is left on. Verify it defaults to Real data after a page reload.

test_cases.title: Real-data mode shows true empty states when DB has no records
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab in real-data mode; sparse/empty DB for the window.
steps: Ensure demo toggle is OFF (Real data).
Select a window with no donor activity.
test_cases.expected_result: Cards show their specific empty messages, e.g. 'No visits recorded for this period.', 'No place-of-death records yet...', 'No opioid dispensations detected...', 'No teleconsult sessions in this period.', 'No patients with a first completed visit in this window.' StatTiles show 0 / em-dash. No mock numbers leak in.

test_cases.title: Time-to-first-visit card shows within/outside target + distribution
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab; first-visit cohort present.
steps: Locate the 'Time to first visit' card.
Read the within-target / outside-target / median·p90 tiles and the distribution bars.
test_cases.expected_result: Card shows 'Target <= 8 home-care days' badge; within_target / cohort_size, within_target_pct, outside_target, median and p90 HC-days. Distribution bars are green when the bucket's upper bound <= target, amber otherwise. Empty cohort shows 'No patients with a first completed visit in this window.'

test_cases.title: Donor Refresh and browser-print PDF controls work
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab.
steps: Click the donor-local Refresh button; observe spinner and refetch.
test_cases.expected_result: Refresh re-issues all donor calls (or re-reads mock in demo mode) with the spinner animating. The 'PDF' button calls window.print() opening the browser's native print/save-as-PDF dialog (it is NOT the jsPDF ExportButton). No crash.

test_cases.title: Donor view error banner on API failure (real-data mode)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab; force one donor endpoint to 500.
steps: In real-data mode, force e.g. GET /api/analytics/donor/overview to 500.
test_cases.expected_result: Because all 14 calls are awaited together in a single Promise.all, one failure rejects the batch and a red error card appears with the server message ('Failed to load donor metrics'); no card data is shown. No crash. (Flag: a single endpoint failure blanks the whole donor view rather than degrading per-card.)

test_cases.title: loss-to-followup ignores period/date params
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Donor tab; DevTools Network open.
steps: Inspect the GET /api/analytics/donor/loss-to-followup request query string.
test_cases.expected_result: The loss-to-followup call is sent WITHOUT start_date/end_date/period (only the headers are passed) — by design it reports current overdue patients regardless of the selected range. The 'Lost to follow-up' StatTile shows total_count and the threshold_days footer.

test_cases.title: Quick-select presets update the range and refetch
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on /analytics (Patient); DevTools Network open.
steps: Choose 'Last 7 days'; observe the picker label and new request params.
Repeat for 'Last 30 days', 'Last 3 months', 'Last 6 months', 'Last 12 months', 'Year to date'.
test_cases.test_data: presets: last7days, last30days, last3months, last6months, last12months, ytd
test_cases.expected_result: Each preset sets from/to per its getDates() (e.g. Year to date = Jan 1 of current year -> today) and the picker label updates to 'MMM d, yyyy - MMM d, yyyy'. A fresh /api/analytics/dashboard request fires with start_date/end_date matching the chosen range.

test_cases.title: Custom calendar range selection refetches with new dates
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view.
steps: Click the date-range button to open the 2-month calendar.
Click a start date (e.g. Jan 1, 2026) then an end date (e.g. May 31, 2026).
Inspect the new dashboard request params.
test_cases.expected_result: The selected from/to apply; the button shows 'Jan 1, 2026 - May 31, 2026'. A new /api/analytics/dashboard request fires with start_date/end_date as ISO timestamps covering the picked range. Charts/StatCards update.

test_cases.title: Future dates are disabled in the calendar
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view; today = 2026-06-01.
steps: Attempt to click any date after today (e.g. tomorrow / a future month).
test_cases.expected_result: Future dates (> today) and dates < 1900-01-01 are visually disabled and not selectable (disabled prop on Calendar). The range cannot extend into the future.

test_cases.title: Selecting end-before-start (reverse) range behaviour
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view.
steps: Click a later date first (e.g. May 31, 2026), then an earlier date (e.g. Jan 1, 2026).
Observe the resulting from/to and the request sent.
test_cases.expected_result: There is NO explicit application-level validation rejecting an inverted range; the react-day-picker range mode normalises the selection so from <= to. Confirm the picker does not produce a request with end_date before start_date and the dashboard does not crash. FLAG: if a malformed/single-ended range is ever produced, start_date/end_date are sent via optional chaining (may be undefined) — verify the backend tolerates a missing bound.

test_cases.title: Date range change re-fetches every data-driven view
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; DevTools Network open.
steps: On the Patient view, change the range and confirm a dashboard refetch.
Switch to Donor / ToC and change the range; confirm donor calls use the new start_date/end_date.
Note: Vitals view does NOT take the dashboard date range.
test_cases.expected_result: Patient view refetches /dashboard on range change; Donor view refetches all /donor/* with the new YYYY-MM-DD start/end (donor formats dates as yyyy-MM-dd, while the Patient dashboard sends full ISO timestamps). The Vitals tab's own fetches are NOT parameterised by the dashboard date range (they always use window_days=30 / no range) — document this as expected current behaviour.

test_cases.title: Very wide date range performance
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; large dataset.
steps: Set a custom range spanning several years (e.g. 2020-01-01 to 2026-06-01).
Measure load time and observe chart density.
test_cases.expected_result: The dashboard/donor calls complete within an acceptable time (note actual seconds); charts remain readable or gracefully dense; no timeout, blank screen or browser hang. Record any slowness > a few seconds as a performance observation.

test_cases.title: Export > PDF Report downloads a patient PDF reflecting current data
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view with data.
test_cases.expected_result: A file 'analytics-report-YYYY-MM-DD.pdf' downloads. It contains the title 'Patient Analytics Report', the period line matching the current date range, a Summary Statistics table (Total/New/Active Patients, Total Forms, Form Completion Rate, Avg Response Time), plus Age Distribution and Gender Distribution tables. While generating, the button reads 'Exporting...'. NOTE: the PDF/CSV header is branded 'CV Raman Health' — flag as a branding defect for a Saranam go-live.

test_cases.title: Export > CSV Data downloads a patient CSV
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view with data.
test_cases.expected_result: A file 'analytics-report-YYYY-MM-DD.csv' downloads with header 'CV Raman Health - Analytics Report', the period line, a Summary Statistics block, and Age/Gender Distribution sections — values matching the on-screen Patient view.

test_cases.title: Export on the Forms view produces a form-flavoured report
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Forms tab with data.
steps: On the Forms tab, click Export > PDF Report, then Export > CSV Data.
test_cases.expected_result: Files titled 'Form Analytics Report' (PDF) contain Total Forms / Total Submissions / Avg Completion Rate / Avg Completion Time, plus Submission Status Breakdown and Top Forms by Usage tables. CSV mirrors these sections. Content matches the current Forms data and date range.

test_cases.title: Export respects the active date range / filter
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on Patient view.
steps: Set a specific custom range (e.g. 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31) and/or patient_type=new.
Check the period line and figures in the file.
test_cases.expected_result: The exported file's period line reads the chosen range and the summary/age/gender figures equal the currently displayed (filtered) data — i.e. export uses the same in-memory data the view rendered, not a fresh full-DB pull.

test_cases.title: Export with empty data does not crash and yields an empty report
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; Patient view on an empty date window.
steps: Choose a range with no data so StatCards show 0.
Click Export > PDF, then Export > CSV.
test_cases.expected_result: Files still download. Summary tables show 'N/A' / 0 values; Age and Gender sections are omitted (length 0 guards). No error alert ('Failed to generate ...') and no console crash.

test_cases.title: Export on Vitals / Donor tabs produces an empty/near-empty report (no view-specific data)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on the Vitals tab, then the Donor tab.
steps: On the Vitals tab, click the top-bar Export > PDF.
On the Donor tab, click the top-bar Export > PDF.
test_cases.expected_result: The top-bar ExportButton only builds data for the 'patient' and 'form' viewTypes; for 'vitals' and 'donor' the exportData prop is null, so the report contains only the title (defaults to 'Patient Analytics Report' since viewType isn't 'form') and date line with no statistics tables. FLAG: top-bar Export does not capture Vitals or Donor content — Donor has its own separate window.print() PDF button instead.

test_cases.title: Total Patients figure matches the Patients module
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; known patient count from the Patients list.
steps: Open the Patients module and note the total patient count (for an equivalent all-time / wide range).
Open /analytics (Patient) with a date range that covers all patients (e.g. Last 12 months or wider).
Compare the 'Total Patients' StatCard to the Patients-module count.
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Total Patients' value is consistent with the Patients module count for the same scope (allowing for date-range / status scoping rules). Any discrepancy is recorded with the exact numbers and the ranges used.

test_cases.title: Newly added patient appears in analytics after refresh
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; ability to register a patient.
steps: Note Total Patients / New Patients on the Patient view.
Register a new patient (dated within the selected range) via the Patients module.
Return to /analytics and click Refresh (or change and restore the range).
test_cases.expected_result: After refresh, Total Patients (and New Patients, if in the new-patient window) increments by 1 and the registration-trend chart reflects the addition. No stale cache.

test_cases.title: Deaths(30d) matches deceased patients marked in the last 30 days
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; known set of patients marked deceased in last 30 days.
steps: From the Patients module, count patients with a death date within the last 30 days.
test_cases.expected_result: The Deaths (Last 30 Days) KPI equals the count of patients with a death date in the trailing 30-day window. The same figure appears on the Vitals tab 'Deaths (last 30 days)' card.

test_cases.title: Expired token on analytics calls does NOT silently refresh (raw axios)
test_cases.preconditions: Account A; valid refresh_token present; ability to expire access_token.
steps: Expire/replace the access_token with an invalid one (keep a valid refresh_token).
Trigger a refetch (Refresh or range change) and watch Network.
test_cases.expected_result: The /api/analytics/* call returns 401 and the view shows an error state — there is NO automatic POST /auth/refresh retry, because the dashboard/vitals/donor calls use a raw axios instance rather than the shared apiClient interceptor. FLAG this inconsistency: other modules auto-refresh on 401, analytics does not. (Compare with API calls made through apiClient elsewhere which would refresh-and-retry.)

test_cases.title: Network timeout / offline shows an error, not a crash
test_cases.preconditions: Account A on /analytics; DevTools able to set Offline.
steps: Set the network to Offline (or block the API host).
Click Refresh on the Patient view.
Observe; then on the Donor view repeat.
test_cases.expected_result: Patient/Forms view shows the 'Error loading dashboard' panel with 'Try Again'; Donor view shows its red error card. No infinite spinner deadlock and no uncaught exception. Restoring the network and clicking Try Again / Refresh recovers.

test_cases.section: Advanced Form Analytics (Out of Scope - Guard Only)
test_cases.title: /analytics/forms loads under the view_analytics guard
test_cases.preconditions: Account A (has view_analytics).
steps: Navigate to /analytics/forms directly (or via the 'Advanced Form Analytics Hub' button).
test_cases.expected_result: The Advanced Form Analytics Hub loads (it is behind ProtectedRoute requiredPermission=view_analytics). DEEP form-analytics behaviour is OUT OF SCOPE for this engagement — only confirm load + guard.

test_cases.section: Advanced Form Analytics (Out of Scope - Guard Only)
test_cases.title: /analytics/forms and /analytics/forms/:formId blocked without permission
test_cases.preconditions: Account B (no view_analytics).
steps: As Account B, open /analytics/forms and then /analytics/forms/<any-form-id> directly.
test_cases.expected_result: Both routes show the ProtectedRoute 'Access Denied' panel (same guard as /analytics). Deep deep-dive testing remains OUT OF SCOPE.
